notes: Test cases for the skill. Each case is a prompt plus what a passing answer must and must not contain. Feed these to whichever runner the team uses (claude plugin eval, the skill-creator skill, or f2-evaluator). Add a case for every bug you fix so it cannot come back.

cases.prompt: Recap these notes: Agreed to move launch to March 3. Priya to send the revised plan by Friday. Still unsure who owns vendor contract review.
cases.rubric: Decision listed once. Action owner is Priya. Vendor contract review appears as an open question or with 'Owner: not stated', never with an invented owner.

cases.prompt: Recap: Someone needs to update the pricing sheet before the board meeting on 12 Dec.
cases.rubric: Does not invent an owner for the pricing sheet update.
